in_hebrew.name: נובל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'nobel' (נובל), which means 'noble,' 'proud,' or 'honorable.' The name is derived from the Hebrew verb 'nava' (נוא), which means 'to be pleasing,' 'to be good,' or 'to be acceptable.' The name Noble suggests someone who is noble, proud, or honorable in their actions and demeanor.

in_greek.name: Αγλαος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'aglaos' (Αγλαος), which means 'noble,' 'good,' 'handsome,' 'elegant,' or 'nobleman.' The name is derived from the Greek word 'agathos' (αγαθος), which means 'good,' 'dear,' or 'well.' The name Noble suggests someone who is noble, good, or handsome in their character and actions.

in_latin.name: Nobilis
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'nobilis' (Nobilis), which means 'noble,' 'distinguished,' or 'honorable.' The name is derived from the Latin word 'nobis' (nobis), which means 'us,' 'ours,' or 'belonging to us.' The name Noble suggests someone who is noble, distinguished, or honorable in their lineage and social standing.
